select * from ( select
from usage_record ur left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.id left join lab l on ur.lab_id = l.id
union all
select -1000000000 - r.id as id, r.applicant_user_id as userId, r.lab_id as labId, convert(concat('RES-', r.id) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as recordNo, convert(coalesce(r.applicant_name, '预约用户') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as person, convert(case when l.lab_name is null then cast(r.lab_id as char) when l.lab_code is null or l.lab_code = '' or convert(l.lab_name using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat(convert(l.lab_code using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') then l.lab_name else concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as resource, convert(coalesce(r.scene, '预约使用') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as scene, case when trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', 1)) regexp '^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' then str_to_date(concat(r.reservation_date, ' ', trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', 1))), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') else coalesce(r.updated_at, r.created_at) end as useTime, convert(case when r.reservation_date = curdate() and trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', 1)) regexp '^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', -1)) regexp '^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and curtime() between str_to_date(trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', 1)), '%H:%i') and str_to_date(trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', -1)), '%H:%i') then '使用中' else '正常' end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as status, convert(concat('预约审批通过，预约编号', r.id, '；', coalesce(r.reason, r.scene, '预约使用')) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as remark, convert(coalesce(r.department, '预约用户') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as role, convert(coalesce(r.scene, '预约使用') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as type, convert(case when l.lab_name is null then cast(r.lab_id as char) when l.lab_code is null or l.lab_code = '' or convert(l.lab_name using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat(convert(l.lab_code using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') then l.lab_name else concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as lab, convert(case when trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', -1)) regexp '^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' then date_format(str_to_date(concat(r.reservation_date, ' ', trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', -1))), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), '%m-%d %H:%i') else '-' end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as leaveTime, convert(coalesce(r.time_range, '-') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as duration, convert('预约审核通过，已纳入实验室使用安排' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as accessResult, convert(coalesce(r.reviewer_name, '系统') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as reviewer, convert('-' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as abnormalReason, convert(concat('来源：预约；预约编号', r.id) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as note, convert('预约' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as sourceType, cast(r.id as char) as sourceId, true as readonly, r.created_at as createdAt, r.updated_at as updatedAt from lab_reservation r left join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id where r.status in ('已通过', '通过', '使用中') and not exists ( select 1 from usage_record ur where convert(ur.remark using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci like convert(concat('%预约编号', r.id, '%') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci or ( convert(ur.person using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(r.applicant_name using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci and convert(ur.scene using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(coalesce(r.scene, '预约使用') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci and ur.use_time = case when trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', 1)) regexp '^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' then str_to_date(concat(r.reservation_date, ' ', trim(substring_index(r.time_range, '-', 1))), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') else coalesce(r.updated_at, r.created_at) end ) )
union all
select -2000000000 - t.id as id, null as userId, l.id as labId, convert(concat('COURSE-', t.id) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as recordNo, convert(coalesce(t.class_name, t.row_class_name, '课程班级') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as person, convert(case when l.lab_name is null then t.classroom when l.lab_code is null or l.lab_code = '' or convert(l.lab_name using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat(convert(l.lab_code using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') then l.lab_name else concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as resource, convert('课程上机' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as scene, str_to_date( concat( curdate(), ' ', case ceil(coalesce(t.start_section, t.end_section, 0) / 2) when 1 then '08:30' when 2 then '10:20' when 3 then '14:00' when 4 then '15:50' when 5 then '18:40' when 6 then '20:20' else '00:00' end ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i' ) as useTime, convert(case when case ceil(coalesce(t.start_section, t.end_section, 0) / 2) when 1 then '08:30:00' when 2 then '10:20:00' when 3 then '14:00:00' when 4 then '15:50:00' when 5 then '18:40:00' when 6 then '20:20:00' else '23:59:59' end <= curtime() and case ceil(coalesce(t.end_section, t.start_section, 0) / 2) when 1 then '10:00:00' when 2 then '11:50:00' when 3 then '15:30:00' when 4 then '17:20:00' when 5 then '20:10:00' when 6 then '21:50:00' else '00:00:00' end >= curtime() then '使用中' else '正常' end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as status, convert(concat('课程：', coalesce(t.course_name, '-'), '；教师：', coalesce(t.teacher, '-'), '；教室：', coalesce(t.classroom, '-')) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as remark, convert('课程班级' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as role, convert('课程上机' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as type, convert(case when l.lab_name is null then t.classroom when l.lab_code is null or l.lab_code = '' or convert(l.lab_name using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat(convert(l.lab_code using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') then l.lab_name else concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as lab, convert(date_format( str_to_date( concat( curdate(), ' ', case ceil(coalesce(t.end_section, t.start_section, 0) / 2) when 1 then '10:00' when 2 then '11:50' when 3 then '15:30' when 4 then '17:20' when 5 then '20:10' when 6 then '21:50' else '00:00' end ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i' ), '%m-%d %H:%i' ) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as leaveTime, convert(coalesce(t.section_text, '-') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as duration, convert('课表匹配，已纳入实验室使用安排' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as accessResult, convert('系统' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as reviewer, convert('-' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as abnormalReason, convert(concat('来源：课表；课程：', coalesce(t.course_name, '-'), '；教师：', coalesce(t.teacher, '-')) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as note, convert('课表' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as sourceType, cast(t.id as char) as sourceId, true as readonly, t.create_time as createdAt, t.create_time as updatedAt from class_timetable t join lab l on ( ( nullif(l.lab_code, '') is not null and regexp_like( convert(t.classroom using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, concat( '(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])', replace(convert(l.lab_code using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '-', '[-]'), '[A-Za-z]?([^0-9A-Za-z]|$)' ) ) ) or ( nullif(l.lab_name, '') is not null and locate( convert(l.lab_name using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, convert(t.classroom using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci ) > 0 ) ) join timetable_integration_config crawler_config on crawler_config.config_key = 'lab-admin-class-timetable' where find_in_set( convert(cast(least(25, greatest(1, floor(datediff( curdate(), crawler_config.semester_start_date ) / 7) + 1)) as char) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, convert(t.week_expanded using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci ) > 0 and convert(t.semester using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(crawler_config.semester using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci and convert(t.weekday using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(case dayofweek(curdate()) when 1 then '星期日' when 2 then '星期一' when 3 then '星期二' when 4 then '星期三' when 5 then '星期四' when 6 then '星期五' when 7 then '星期六' end using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci ) usageRecords order by useTime desc, id desc

select
from usage_record ur left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.id left join lab l on ur.lab_id = l.id where ur.id = #{id}
select min(id) from sys_user where real_name = #{person} group by real_name having count(*) = 1

select count(1) from usage_record where convert(person using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(cast(#{person} as char) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci and convert(resource using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(cast(#{resource} as char) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci and convert(scene using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(cast(#{scene} as char) using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci and use_time = #{useTime}
mapper.update: update usage_record set person = #{record.person}, resource = #{record.resource}, user_id = #{record.userId}, lab_id = #{record.labId}, scene = #{record.scene}, use_time = #{record.useTime}, status = #{record.status}, remark = #{record.remark}, source_type = #{record.sourceType}, source_id = #{record.sourceId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update usage_record set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
